_about: The Dispatch Counter's job board (VS-14; structure is the Level Designer's, the words are the Writer's placeholder pass, VS-31, 2026-10-09; final text at VS-37, Ross approves). Same shape as world/jobs.json (JobBoard reads that shape). 'board' is the placement id of the job board node in market_dispatch (mk_dp_board). Main job 'Yard 9': taking it sets job_main_taken and hands over the Courier Pass; that flag opens Gate 4's boom barrier (door mk_gt_to_junk). It is done when the slice boss is beaten (flag kasp_beaten). Side 1 'Charge-up delivery' (battery brick to Grandma Ume's window: crate, crate, ledge; done flag job_charge_done) and side 2 'Appeal in triplicate' (Pell's form to the APPEALS slot at Gate 4; done flag job_appeal_done). Job ids are yard_9, charge_up and appeal_market (not main/appeal) so they never clash with Harrow's ids when the two jobs files are merged. Placements.job() and JobBoard read this file in slice mode (GameMode.job_ids). Voice of the slips: the Dispatcher's, clipped and frazzled, stamping things; the deadline is always angry.

yard_9.title: Main: Yard 9
description: MAIN JOB. The Signals scrapyard behind the ore line. Every radio, bell and wind chime they confiscate ends up there. Bring back what is ours.
Obstacles: one (1) sergeant. Show the pass at Gate 4. The deadline is already angry.

take.text: Job taken. Courier Pass stamped onto your badge. It is slightly damp. Do not ask. Gate 4 is through the arch.

taken_text: Yard 9. Pass in hand, Gate 4 through the arch. Why are you still reading?
done_text: Yard 9: CLEARED. One (1) sergeant, dealt with. Stamped DONE. The whole market has been asking about you. Loudly.

charge_up.title: Side: Charge-up delivery
description: SIDE JOB. One battery brick to Grandma Ume's window above the Corner Shop. Two crates, then the ledge.
Pay: a Lucky Bolt and 100 credits. Do NOT touch the cords.

take.text: Battery brick handed over. Heavier than it looks. It hums a little. It seems to like you.

taken_text: Battery brick to Ume's window. Crate, crate, ledge. Cords: untouched.
done_text: Phones charged. Stamped DONE. Pay's on the sill, and Ume says you may touch one cord. Gently.

appeal_market.title: Side: Appeal in triplicate
description: SIDE JOB. Pell on the Wharf has a form. The form wants the APPEALS slot at Gate 4. Do not fold it.
Pay: 150 credits and rations. The slot will say your appeal is important to it. It means it, sort of.

take.text: Job taken. Pell is on the Wharf, and very excited. Brace yourself.

taken_text: Get the form from Pell on the Wharf. Drop it flat in Gate 4's APPEALS slot.
done_text: Appeal filed, in triplicate. (Once, but Pell says it counts.) Stamped DONE.
